doc: Machine-readable twin of capabilities/skills/auto.md -> State table. Consumed by tools/kcc-run. Placeholders: {input} {flags} {silent_assume} {parallel} {fasttrack} {depthlevel} {IDEA} {SPEC} {WAVE} {ITEM} {TOOLS} (comma list derived by kcc-run from the spec dialects; bash passes it as positional args). skip_if_flag is a flag name or a list (parallel, fasttrack); command_fasttrack replaces command under --fasttrack; agent_fasttrack names the agent that runs the state directly (claude --agent) under --fasttrack, with no orchestrator session above it; precheck_requires is an artifact path that must exist before an already-passing exit check may skip the state. Checks nest through then; internal:review-verdict fails unless review.md says APPROVED (exit 3 for TOOLCHAIN_DEFERRED). Args are written PowerShell-style; kcc-run.sh maps -Name to --kebab-name.

states.name: SPECIALISTS
states.command: Run the triggered specialist interrogators for ideation/{IDEA} per auto-mode.md -> Operating scenario 1 -> Step sequence item 6 (ux-ui, security, infrastructure). {silent_assume} {fasttrack} {depthlevel}
states.command_fasttrack: Run only the specialist interrogators the idea needs for ideation/{IDEA}, each in quick mode with short briefs: security when CR-7 triggers (security, privacy, secrets, compliance), infrastructure when the idea is deployable (service, API, web app, container, scheduled job), ux-ui only when it has a user interface. {silent_assume} {fasttrack} {depthlevel}

states.name: ARCH
states.command: Run the architect pass for {IDEA} (CR-2) including the quality-gates catalog, then /architecture-review. {depthlevel}
states.command_fasttrack: Run the architect pass for {IDEA} (CR-2) at architecture depth lite for scripts, libraries, and CLIs but standard for deployable services, APIs, and web apps, including quality-gates (QG-PROD stays for deployables); then run /architecture-review --fasttrack (one lean pass; the architect fixes DRIFT findings once). {fasttrack} {depthlevel}

states.name: CLOSE
states.command: Close the KCC run: butler-remember + memory-append for reusable knowledge, record token actuals, token-guard Mode D.
states.command_fasttrack: Close the fasttrack run: run /butler-remember --fasttrack (memory only: the decisions and preferences worth keeping from this run; no Traces, no token-guard). Then write a short summary (specs built, review verdicts, open bugs, how to run the result, and a gate table QG-QUALITY / QG-TRACE / QG-BUGS / QG-PROD as pass, deferred, or n/a with the reason; never call a deferred gate a pass) to coordination/run/closed.md, print it, and end with the next step `/spec-deploy SPEC-ID`. Never deploy.
